Passionate about wine, taking sommelier courses, planning vineyard visit Bordeaux. Wife's birthday coming March, married to physiotherapist. Follows plant-based diet athlete habits. No allergies. Mentioned starting foundation for young athletes, could be partnership opportunity boutique. Good media presence former professional, 300K followers social media. Interested in durability quality pieces for active lifestyle. Follow up in month with personalized selection. Invite to sports-related VIP events.
